description: Type check on whether the mu3 A=3 words admit a Brunnian re-expression, which would have collapsed the non-cyclic-perblock vs canonical-signed-trace question (the two coincide to machine precision on Brunnian families). They do not: 17 of 35 factors carry an identity admixture c*sigma + d*1 with d != 0, making the words Hecke algebra elements rather than braids, for which Brunnian-ness is undefined. The admixture is the canonical color-weighted averaged crossing and cannot be removed without abandoning that convention.
caveats: scope-(b) STRUCTURAL exclusion, with the invariant named: Brunnian-ness is a property of braid group elements and delete-strand is a braid group homomorphism, so the property is UNDEFINED (not merely false) for an identity-admixed Hecke algebra element. This closes one proposed ROUTE; it does not resolve the underlying trace-convention question (bean qou-8jq2), which remains open and is an owner call.
